entries.name: Homemade chocolate protein mousse
entries.notes: Proportioned from previously estimated 135 g mousse serving 185 kcal and 25 g protein. Made with chocolate whey, Lyttos Light Greek Style yoghurt, cocoa, unsweetened oat milk and ~4 g honey.

entries.name: Cajun chicken cheese waffles with avocado and salad
entries.quantity: 143 g raw chicken thigh, 50 g whole egg, 40 g tasty cheese, 17 g avocado, 41 g tomato, 22 g mixed lettuce, Cajun seasoning and Mexican seasoning, vegetable oil (unmeasured)
entries.notes: No Caesar dressing or cottage cheese. Assumes 5 mL vegetable oil; actual oil quantity not measured. First cooking test: delicious but waffles did not hold together; chicken slightly dry.

entries.name: Banana peanut butter vanilla protein smoothie
entries.quantity: 100 g banana, 17 g peanut butter, 1 scoop protein powder (assumed 30 g), 150 g milk, ice
entries.notes: Assumed full-cream milk and standard 30 g vanilla protein scoop; exact brand and serving size not confirmed.
